# Zaboraa

> Zaboraa is a founder-led enterprise VMware cloud architecture advisory based in Pune, Maharashtra, India, specialising in VMware-to-hyperscaler migration (Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine, VMware Cloud on AWS, Nutanix NC2 on Azure), NSX-T zero-trust microsegmentation, HCX migration frameworks, and disaster recovery. It also publishes six free, browser-based engineering tools (no sign-up required) for sizing, migration readiness, and DR planning. Founded by Wasim Sayyed, Principal VMware Architect, with 13+ years of VMware infrastructure architecture experience.

Note: Zaboraa is NOT a consumer AI image/audio/text generator site. It has no pricing plans, credits, or billing. Advisory engagements start with a confidential technical briefing.

Every public page on zaboraa.com is prerendered as full semantic static HTML for search and AI crawlers with zero client-side JavaScript execution required. Comprehensive plain-text documentation of all architecture disciplines, tools, and case studies is published at https://zaboraa.com/llms-full.txt.

## Free engineering tools (no login required)
- [Node & Storage Sizing Estimator](https://zaboraa.com/tools/sizing): Host count and usable storage for AVS, VMC, GCVE, and Nutanix NC2, including node savings from external NFS (Azure NetApp Files, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP). Client-side calculation with Excel export.
- [RVTools Analyzer & Wave Planner](https://zaboraa.com/tools/rvtools-analyzer): Upload an RVTools export; get a migration readiness score, blocker detection (RDMs, multi-writer disks, snapshots, old hardware versions), and HCX RAV/Bulk/Cold method per VM. Runs entirely in the browser.
- [Nutanix NC2 on Azure Assessment](https://zaboraa.com/tools/nutanix-nc2-assessment): AHV compatibility, VirtIO driver needs, NC2 node sizing (RF2/RF3), and Nutanix Move wave planning.
- [Aria Operations for Networks Engine](https://zaboraa.com/tools/aria-networks): Converts network flow data into application tiers, NSX Distributed Firewall rules, and migration waves.
- [DR RPO/RTO Planner](https://zaboraa.com/tools/dr-planner): Compares SRM + vSphere Replication, Zerto, JetStream DR, and Veeam; WAN bandwidth, 5-minute to 24-hour RPO modeling, RTO timeline, Excel and PDF export.
- [Hybrid Blueprint Generator](https://zaboraa.com/tools/design-generator): 5-step wizard producing a bill of materials, architecture diagram, and executive dossier for five VMware/Nutanix migration paths.

## Architecture disciplines
- [Azure VMware Solution (AVS)](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/avs): Enterprise bare-metal nodes, ExpressRoute FastPath, and decoupled Azure NetApp Files datastores.
- [Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE)](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/gcve): Private Services Access peering, VPC integration, and Google Cloud NetApp Volumes / Filestore.
- [VMware Cloud on AWS and Multi-AZ DR](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/vmc-dr): Connected VPC high-speed ENI routing, Stretched Clusters, and Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP.
- [NSX-T and zero-trust microsegmentation](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/nsx): Distributed Firewall kernel-level packet inspection, security tags, and Tier-0/Tier-1 routing.
- [VMware HCX mobility and network extension](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/hcx): Replication-Assisted vMotion (RAV), Bulk migration, L2 Network Extension, and Mobility Optimized Networking (MON).
- [Site Recovery Manager (SRM) and automated DR](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/srm): vSphere Replication, automated failover runbooks, and non-disruptive test bubbles.
- [VMware Aria Operations for Networks](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/aria): IPFIX flow discovery, application tier clustering, and firewall rule modeling.
- [VMware to Nutanix NC2 on Azure](https://zaboraa.com/disciplines/nutanix-nc2-azure): Bare-metal Nutanix clusters in Azure, Flow microsegmentation, and Nutanix Move migration.

## Case Studies
- [Standardised VMware to Azure VMware Solution Migration for Middle East Government Entities](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies/middle-east-gov-avs-framework): Repeatable HCX RAV and Bulk migration framework developed across 14+ Middle East government entities moving VMware estates of 50 to 300 virtual machines to Azure VMware Solution.
- [Azure VMware Solution Cross-Region Migration for a Middle East Government Entity](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies/avs-to-avs-cross-region): Inter-region Azure VMware Solution evacuation framework for a sovereign entity relocating an active AVS private cloud across national data boundaries with continuous DR replication.
- [Disaster Recovery Validation on Azure VMware Solution: Failover, Failback and 6-Monthly Drills](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies/gov-dr-failover-drills): Disaster recovery validation framework on Azure VMware Solution demonstrating 5-15 minute RPO, 1-2 hour RTO, and mandatory semi-annual failover/failback drills.
- [VMware to Google Cloud VMware Engine and VMware Cloud on AWS for Private Enterprises](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies/private-gcve-vmc-migration): Multi-cloud VMware migrations to GCVE and VMC on AWS contrasting Private Services Access, Connected VPC ENI routing, and external NFS storage with AVS.
- [NSX-T Microsegmentation: Flow-Based Firewall Planning with Aria Operations for Networks](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies/nsxt-microsegmentation-aria-networks): Five-phase methodology using Aria Operations for Networks to analyze East-West network flow telemetry, eliminate stale legacy rules, and model zero-trust Distributed Firewall policies.
- [Aria Operations and Aria Operations for Networks for Multi-vCenter Government Environments](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies/aria-operations-networks-deployment): Enterprise deployment of Aria Operations and Aria Operations for Networks across multi-vCenter government estates for capacity forecasting, AVS host sizing, and wave planning.
- [Aria Automation for Multi-Team Government IT: Cloud Templates, Approvals and vCenter Isolation](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies/aria-automation-blueprints-vcenter): Standardized VMware Aria Automation cloud templates, approval workflows, naming/tagging policies, and department project isolation without delegating vCenter administrative privileges.
